text: Twelve simulated agents at Harborline Cooperative, a fictional co-op. Policy as code, a cost board, and a gate that can go red. Offline. No model call.

Fleet policy on inventory and prompts, dated October seventeenth twenty twenty-six: pass, twelve agents, zero violations. The demo also writes a static board from two thousand sixteen simulated events and three planted alerts.
Invariant eval: three YAML cases, thirty-two property trials, zero breaches.
Forced regression on a bad refund event: three breaches, exit one. Harmful transfer, cost over cap, and an unapproved external write. That red exit is the proof the gate can fail.

Use it to keep owners, caps, and human gates in YAML and in C-I. Not covered: answer quality, a live vendor call, or a real spend finding. Board numbers are simulated. Run python -m governance_board demo after install. Cost of the lab path: zero.
